nodes.label: AI Primary/Fallback Model Architecture
nodes.rationale: Uses Claude Sonnet 4.6 as primary, falls back to Claude Haiku 4.5 on failure or when degraded_mode is true (near daily token limits). Fallback uses lower temperature (0.3) for more deterministic responses.

nodes.label: AI Input/Output Safety Pipeline
